v1-empty.json.description: Empty config — raw array with no rules

v1-mixed.json.description: Mixed config: TCP plus all three UDP modes

v1-wrapper-rules.json.description: Wrapper shape {rules:[...]} — supported by Go service config; TypeScript config requires raw array

v1-raw-array.json.description: UDP rule without explicit udpMode — both runtimes must default to one-way

invalid-duplicate-binding.json.description: Two rules sharing the same protocol+listenHost+listenPort — duplicate binding must be rejected

invalid-port-zero.json.description: listenPort: 0 — below the valid minimum of 1

invalid-port-too-high.json.description: listenPort: 65536 — above the valid maximum of 65535

invalid-missing-name.json.description: Empty string name — name is required

invalid-empty-host.json.description: Empty string listenHost — listenHost is required

invalid-protocol.json.description: protocol: quic — only tcp and udp are accepted

invalid-udp-mode.json.description: udpMode: roundtrip — only one-way, bidirectional-last-client, bidirectional-multi-client are accepted

invalid-json.json.description: Malformed JSON — must not be parsed or loaded
